scope: Owned warrior weapon/shield selection, action/Set confirmation, equipment skill preview and assignment selection lists. Skill effects, acquisition and other compendium readers remain separately owned. Original geometry; numbers in equipment rows are Hunger costs identified by the heading.

entries.bilingual_review: T2 Japanese reread against the native selection and argument order. Weapon/Shield are categories within Skills; the hunger heading identifies parenthesized row costs. Set confirmation preserves equipped-item meaning. Colours and all substitutions are retained.
